items.quote: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments
items.claim: Moses reported to the people all God's words and judgments

items.quote: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do
items.claim: The people unanimously committed to obeying all God's words
items.object: all the words which the LORD hath said
